summary: Author's own review against the critic checklist (no independent critic was run). The delve is routed by depth and slot (test/whisperwood.test.js), every delve card turns back on the left, falls cost what the scene shows, and the Hush's premonitions stay eerie asides (no arc clue, no clock, no door). Fixed during review: the Outcast's and the last witch's lines named a door under the lake (softened to the lake humming); the Hush gate could repeat inside band 4 (now exactly depth 7); the moonpetal locket line could repeat after it was found (its own branch); Isolde's line put Vrell's expulsion in her time, against her age and Maud's (now 'long before my time'); 'Deeper' charged health its lines never show (removed); beast_speech is a retired spell (the ferret takes honey, the foxes Rapport).

issues.problem: The place's drawn card still follows a delve on the same visit (the always-card comes first, then one draw).
issues.fix: Accepted: you come out at the wood's edge, where the ordinary Whisperwood cards are set. Revisit if a playtest finds it odd.

issues.problem: The plan made an angry Spinner a rung harder; a check's rung can't depend on a flag.
issues.fix: An angry Spinner (you freed her hippogriff) won't bargain: the fight comes offended, with no yield.

issues.problem: The plan put the Whisperwood in the midnight pick only once the Hush is known; the place was already open at midnight.
issues.fix: The midnight edge card is what the clue gates; recorded in PROGRESS.md as a deviation.

issues.problem: The plan named Pim, who is a fourth-year's mentee in canon.
